_what: LH-REQ robot quality table. A COMMITTED INPUT FILE, read by the policy, never a constant in policy code: refilling it is a data update that leaves the frozen policy byte-identical.
_ruling: D143 ruling A, D6-compliant: the table is FITTED ON THE DEV SPLIT (28 questions) and LH-REQ robots DRAW ONLY FROM THE EVAL SPLIT (69 questions) in every run. The EVAL and all-97 blocks are recorded for reference and MUST NOT be read by the policy.
_precision_warning: The DEV fit rests on 28 questions, with cloud D2 at 7 of 28 and cloud RECENT at 3 of 28, so the fitted numbers carry wide Wilson intervals. They are recorded beside every point estimate as the user ruled; a freeze that quotes the point estimate alone would overstate its own precision.

_dev_coincidence._now: the measured device scores 2 of 28 on DEV (0.071429) against cloud RECENT's 3 of 28 (0.107143), so THE TIE IS GONE and cloud RECENT now STRICTLY BEATS the device on the DEV fit.
